name: modelscout
description: Cuts token costs and makes subscription usage limits last longer. Knows which AI models you actually have (keys and subscriptions, live pricing), picks the right one for every task, routes it to a best-fit subagent, learns from weak results, and proves what that saved. One open Agent Skills plugin for Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI and Hermes.

interface.shortDescription: Save tokens and usage limits on every task
interface.longDescription: ModelScout cuts token costs and makes subscription usage limits last longer. It knows which AI models you actually have (keys and subscriptions, live pricing), shows a short card for each task (tier, best-fit model, why), routes the work to a right-sized subagent, learns which models hold up, and measures what that saved from real logs. The same open Agent Skill runs in Codex, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Hermes.
defaultPrompt: ModelScout, which model should I use for this task?
Which of my models is cheapest for renaming a field across files?
